references.text: Confirmation of Asenath's role as the mother of Joseph's sons and thus the founder of the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh.
Contrast between Hadad (an enemy who receives help from Pharaoh) and Joseph (a savior who is elevated by Pharaoh), demonstrating God's sovereignty over Egypt.
Narrative connection: Joseph's own settlement (41:45) leads to the family's settlement in the region of Rameses (47:11).
Contrast between Pharaoh's actions: he sends Abraham away in judgment, but sends Joseph out to power and deliverance.
